summary: Admin JWT authentication testing complete. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). All 7 frontend auth flow tests passed. Login, logout, /me endpoint, and change-password all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials returns token, email, role, id
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong email returns 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with empty credentials returns error
Backend: POST /api/auth/login is case-insensitive for email
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with valid Bearer token returns user info (id, email, role, name)
Backend: GET /api/auth/me without token returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with invalid token returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with malformed auth header returns 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password with wrong current password returns 400
Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password with short new password (<6 chars) returns 400
Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password without auth returns 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password with valid data changes password (tested and reverted)
Backend: POST /api/auth/logout returns success status
Backend: POST /api/auth/logout clears access_token cookie
Backend: Public endpoints work without auth (/api/health, /api/settings, /api/weather, /api/images)
Frontend: Admin panel at /admin shows login page when not authenticated
Frontend: Login form shows error message on bad credentials ('Invalid email or password')
Frontend: After successful login, admin dashboard is shown with all 7 tabs
Frontend: Header shows user email (admin@lobbydisplay.com), Password button, and Logout button
Frontend: Clicking Password button opens Change Password modal with 3 fields (current, new, confirm)
Frontend: Password change modal shows error for wrong current password
Frontend: Clicking Logout clears auth and returns to login page
Frontend: Lobby display at / works without auth (public page)
critical_code_review_comments: JWT authentication properly implemented with bcrypt password hashing
Token stored in both httpOnly cookie and returned in response for flexibility
Admin user seeded on startup from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars
seed_admin() updates password if env var changes (idempotent)
Password change requires current password verification (security best practice)
Token has 24hr expiry with proper JWT validation

test_credentials.note: Password was tested with change-password flow and reverted back to original

seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded automatically on backend startup from env vars
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT auth fully implemented and tested. Admin credentials: admin@lobbydisplay.com / Admin@2026!. Token stored in localStorage (admin_token) and httpOnly cookie.
